selection: Prior-week validation chooses each method's training budget; refit from scratch on all prior training and validation days; fixed refit checkpoint only.
scope: Monthly forward evaluation, June through October 2019, across all 25 available households. Each test month is disjoint from that month's training. Earlier observed months become historical training data for later folds. October is never used to train any reported model. One seed; between-home SD measures heterogeneity, not seed uncertainty or unseen-home generalization.
representation: 17 raw physical observations plus 8 history/calendar coordinates, 18 hourly forecasts and 6 horizon-validity masks
rules: Use identical labeled context examples and policy architecture for every method.
Only complete days preceding the forecast query block can provide context labels.
Use train-only scaling during selection; refit scaling and predictors on training plus validation for each final monthly model.
Do not inspect any test outcomes until all monthly refits and selected budgets are frozen.
Retain all methods and months, including losses.
Keep original simulator constraints, tariffs, service targets and oracle objective unchanged.
No winter, unseen-household, real-home savings, formal privacy, or state-of-the-art claim from this dataset.
stopping_rule: Stable validation plateau: at least 3000 episodes, 20 checks spanning 2000 episodes; no reward improvement above 0.005 and adjacent-window reward, comfort, electrical-cost and import drift/SD within declared tolerances. Maximum 20000 episodes; capped runs are not labelled converged.
